description: This is a Java unit test class for the DeleteAttributeStrategy in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of deleting attributes from a 'Thing', including successful deletions and various error scenarios when attributes or paths are missing.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for the DeleteAttributeStrategy, testing attribute deletion logic in the context of Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test method, creating a new instance of DeleteAttributeStrategy.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the DeleteAttributeStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteAttribute
methods.description: Tests the successful deletion of an attribute from a Thing.

methods.name: deleteAttributeFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to delete an attribute from a Thing that has no attributes.

methods.name: deleteAttributeFromThingWithoutThatAttribute
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to delete an attribute that does not exist on the Thing.

methods.name: deleteFromComplexNestedAttributeWithoutThatPath
methods.description: Tests deletion from a nested attribute path that does not exist, expecting an error.

methods.name: deleteFromFlatAttributeWithoutThatPath
methods.description: Tests deletion from a flat attribute with a non-existent nested path, expecting an error.
